key_provisions_or_claims: Understanding the societal and legal impact of autonomous robots requires an interdisciplinary approach.
Focus on justice, equality and fairness in the context of autonomous robots.
Moral responsibility is key to assessing whether autonomous AI creates a responsibility gap.
Avoid treating autonomous robots as entirely new; draw lessons from historical technology governance.
Regulation should focus on societal values to protect, not only on the technology itself.
annotation.summary_en: Ukrainian philosophy-of-law article arguing that the societal and legal impact of autonomous robots requires an interdisciplinary approach. It stresses justice, moral responsibility and responsibility gaps, and uses Toffler's civilizational waves and the concept of social singularity to argue that regulation should focus on societal values rather than on the technology alone.
